title: Microsoft Internet Explorer CSS Transition Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. By setting a "background" style property in a specific way and then performing a visual transition, an attacker can cause Internet Explorer to write beyond an allocated region of memory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the browser.
